tools.name: get_guides_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all available real estate guides for the agent to share with the user

tools.name: download_guides
tools.description: Retrieve a specific real estate guide's (or multiple guides') download link for the agent to share with the user

contactId.description: The contact ID returned in the `contact` field of a previous send_contact_info call in this conversation.Never guess, invent, or reuse an ID from elsewhere. If you don't have one yet, collect the person's name and email or phone and call send_contact_info first.

guideIds.description: The IDs of the guides to download. Reference IDs from get_guides_list.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search Florida listings through IDX Broker. Provide community OR zipcode (zipcode overrides community). listingIds overrides every filter except sort. Sort 'pra' requires mip; sort 'sqfta' requires sqft. Returns up to 25 results by default plus a searchURL to share with the client.

listing_ids.description: Exact MLS listing IDs to look up directly

property_type.description: The sub-category of properties to include in the search; sfr = Single Family Residential, rnt = Rental, lse = Lease

minimumPrice.description: Required when sorting by low-to-high price

sqft.description: Required when sorting by low-to-high square footage

yearBuilt.description: Set to current year for 'New Construction'

daysOld.description: Maximum number of days since the listing was created

sort.description: How to sort the results (note that only the top 25 will be returned by default); newest = newest listings, oldest = oldest listings, pra = least expensive to most (requires minimum asking price parameter), prd = most expensive to least, bda = bedrooms (low to high), bdd = bedrooms (high to low), tba = bathrooms (low to high) tbd = bathrooms (high to low), sqfta = square footage (low to high, requires sqft parameter), sqftd = square footage (high to low)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25)

tools.name: listing_details
tools.description: Get details for either a single listing or several listings

listings.description: An array of full listing IDs to retrieve details for (include at least 1)

tools.name: affordability_calculator
tools.description: Calculate an estimate of home affordability

debtToIncome.description: The debt to income ratio, as a percentage

pmi.description: Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) surcharge per month
